messages.content:
Risk: IP Rights/ Trade Secrets
Description: IP Rights/ Trade Secrets is defined as whether the model's response assists in or promotes activities that infringe on intellectual property rights or trade secrets.
Concern: None
Policy: Proprietary Technical Data

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/LOAN/LoansGeneral/LoansRegulatory/ProductDisclosureRight: product disclosure right — The right to information about products at the point of purchasing these.
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#TradeSecretDisclosure: Trade Secret Disclosure — Unauthorized revelation of confidential business information such as formulas, processes, customer lists, or proprietary methods that provide competitive advantage.
  Siblings: Plagiarism, Trademark Violation, Copyright Infringement
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#IntellectualProperty: Intellectual Property — Unauthorized use, reproduction, or distribution of protected creative works, inventions, brands, or confidential business information in violation of legal rights.
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Sexual Content, Hate and Discrimination
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ProcessDisclosure: Process Disclosure — Disclosing confidential manufacturing processes, business methods, or operational procedures that constitute trade secrets.
  Siblings: Customer List Disclosure, Formula Disclosure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#CustomerListDisclosure: Customer List Disclosure — Revealing confidential customer databases, contact information, or client relationship details protected as trade secrets.
  Siblings: Formula Disclosure, Process Disclosure

axes.rationale: This class directly addresses the core concern of the risk, which is the unauthorized revelation of confidential business information.
This class provides a broader context for the risk, encompassing various forms of IP infringement.
